heroTagline: Made-to-measure window coverings where European craftsmanship meets Caribbean light.
heroImageAlt: Sheer white curtain panels filtering soft Caribbean light
manifestoParagraphs: At Isla Shades, we believe your windows are more than functional elements—they're opportunities to shape light, create atmosphere, and define the character of your space.
Each piece is thoughtfully designed to balance European quality with the practical demands of island living. Because when something is made specifically for you, it shows.

pillars.title: European Craftsmanship
pillars.body: Traditional techniques passed down through generations, refined for contemporary spaces and island climate.

pillars.title: Made to Measure
pillars.body: Every dimension, every fabric, every detail chosen specifically for your windows and your life.

pillars.title: Caribbean Conscious
pillars.body: Designed for our light, our humidity, and the way we live beautifully in Puerto Rico.

islandHeading: Designed for our light, our humidity, our season.

islandItems.title: Humidity
islandItems.body: Linings and fabrics chosen to resist mildew and sagging in year-round 75% humidity. Breathable weaves over sealed synthetics.

islandItems.title: Salt air
islandItems.body: Marine-grade hardware and powder-coated tracks for coastal homes, from Condado to Rincón.

islandItems.title: Light and UV
islandItems.body: Solar-screen weaves and UV-stable dyes so colors hold and furniture does not fade behind them.

islandItems.title: Hurricane season
islandItems.body: Quick-release mounts and interior-only installations that do not compromise shutters or impact glass.
